name: Ignore All Boot Failures
description: Disables boot failure recovery prompts so Windows continues starting without interruption, but requires a restart to apply.

description_i18n.en: Disables boot failure recovery prompts so Windows continues starting without interruption, but requires a restart to apply.
description_i18n.de: Deaktiviert Wiederherstellungsaufforderungen bei Bootfehlern, sodass der Start ohne Unterbrechung fortgesetzt wird; ein Neustart ist erforderlich.
description_i18n.fr: Désactive les invites de récupération en cas d'échec du démarrage pour que Windows continue sans interruption ; un redémarrage est requis.

warnings.title: Boot behavior change
warnings.message: This tweak updates boot configuration values that affect startup recovery prompts and error handling

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Modifies the boot configuration registry value BootStatusPolicy to IgnoreAllFailures using bcdedit
